keyEvents.text: Joe Williams (Bristol City) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Goal! Bolton Wanderers 0, Bristol City 1. Dom Ballard (Bristol City) right footed shot from very close range to the centre of the goal. Assisted by Jason Knight with a cross.
Goal! Bolton Wanderers 1, Bristol City 1. Josh Sheehan (Bolton Wanderers) right footed shot from outside the box to the bottom right corner. Assisted by Thierry Gale.
Delay in match because of an injury Jason Knight (Bristol City).
Josh Sheehan (Bolton Wanderers) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Substitution, Bristol City. Yu Hirakawa replaces Brian De Keersmaecker.
Substitution, Bristol City. Jed Wallace replaces Rio Cardines.
Goal! Bolton Wanderers 2, Bristol City 1. Sam Dalby (Bolton Wanderers) right footed shot from the centre of the box to the centre of the goal. Assisted by Atsuki Ito following a fast break.
Substitution, Bolton Wanderers. Rúben Rodrigues replaces Atsuki Ito.
Substitution, Bolton Wanderers. Kyliane Dong replaces Thierry Gale.
Substitution, Bristol City. Scott Twine replaces Dom Ballard.
Delay in match because of an injury Chris Forino (Bolton Wanderers).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Substitution, Bolton Wanderers. Lewis Brunt replaces Chris Forino because of an injury.
Substitution, Bristol City. Sam Bell replaces Lorent Tolaj.
Substitution, Bristol City. Adam Randell replaces Joe Williams.
Goal! Bolton Wanderers 2, Bristol City 2. Sam Bell (Bristol City) right footed shot from very close range to the centre of the goal. Assisted by Cameron Pring with a cross.
Substitution, Bolton Wanderers. Akin Famewo replaces Ben Davies.
Substitution, Bolton Wanderers. Max Lott replaces Samuel Iling-Junior.
Goal! Bolton Wanderers 2, Bristol City 3. Scott Twine (Bristol City) right footed shot from the centre of the box to the bottom right corner. Assisted by Jed Wallace following a fast break.
